capex_guidance.detail: On the Q4 FY26 call, Hood said underlying CY2026 capex investment plans are unchanged, but the figure is now framed as ~$175B (vs. prior ~$190B) purely because a useful-life extension (15→25 yrs) shifts new data-center leases from finance to operating leases, which drops out of reported capex.

capex_guidance.headline: $195-205B FY2026 capex, raised from $180-190B
capex_guidance.detail: On the Q2 2026 call, CFO Anat Ashkenazi raised full-year 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B from the prior $180-190B range given after Q1 2026, citing accelerated delivery of AI/data center capacity to meet demand. Management also flagged 2027 capex will increase significantly further.

capex_guidance.detail: Meta narrowed full-year 2026 capex guidance, including finance lease principal payments, to $130-145B from the prior $125-145B range given last quarter. Floor raised $5B, ceiling held, driven by continued AI/data center buildout.

capex_guidance.headline: $25B+ FY2026 capex
capex_guidance.detail: CFO Vaibhav Taneja reiterated full-year 2026 capex will be more than $25 billion, funding robotaxi fleet expansion, AI compute infrastructure, Optimus production, and chip fab investments. Guidance is unchanged from the Q1 2026 call; capex expected to keep growing over the next 2-3 years.
